name: pyscf_front
description: A quantum chemical calculation app using Electron, React, and Python.

scripts.dev:codegen: npm run codegen && npm run dev
scripts.dev:clean: rimraf dist node_modules/.vite && npm run dev
scripts.build: npm run verify-env && npm run clean:build-artifacts && npm run codegen && npm run build:electron && npm run build:conda-pack && npm run validate-build
scripts.package: npm run build && electron-builder && npm run verify:asar-artifacts
scripts.package:linux: npm run build:linux && electron-builder --linux && npm run verify:asar-artifacts
scripts.build:linux: npm run verify-env && npm run clean:build-artifacts && npm run codegen && npm run build:electron && npm run build:conda-pack && npm run build:python:linux && npm run validate-build
scripts.codegen: npm run codegen:python && npm run codegen:typescript
scripts.codegen:check: npm run codegen && git diff --exit-code -- src/python/generated_models.py src/web/types/generated-api.ts
scripts.conda-lock:generate: conda-lock -f .github/environment.yml --lockfile .github/pyscf-env.conda-lock.yml -p osx-arm64 -p osx-64 -p linux-64 && conda-lock render --kind explicit --filename-template .github/conda-locks/pyscf-env-{platform}.lock .github/pyscf-env.conda-lock.yml
scripts.codegen:python: cd src/python && bash -c 'CONDA_BASE=$(conda info --base 2>/dev/null || echo "$HOME/miniforge3") && source "$CONDA_BASE/etc/profile.d/conda.sh" && conda activate pyscf-env && datamodel-codegen --input ../../src/api-spec/openapi.yaml --output generated_models.py --output-model-type pydantic_v2.BaseModel --field-constraints --use-schema-description --disable-timestamp'
scripts.verify-env: bash -c 'CONDA_BASE=$(conda info --base 2>/dev/null || echo "$HOME/miniforge3") && source "$CONDA_BASE/etc/profile.d/conda.sh" && conda activate pyscf-env && $(conda info --base)/envs/pyscf-env/bin/python scripts/verify-environment.py'
scripts.verify-build-env: bash -c 'CONDA_BASE=$(conda info --base 2>/dev/null || echo "$HOME/miniforge3") && source "$CONDA_BASE/etc/profile.d/conda.sh" && conda activate pyscf-env && echo "=== Build Environment Verification ===" && $(conda info --base)/envs/pyscf-env/bin/python -c "import conda_pack; print(f\"conda-pack: {conda_pack.__version__}\")" && $(conda info --base)/envs/pyscf-env/bin/python -c "import gunicorn; print(f\"Gunicorn: {gunicorn.__version__}\")" && $(conda info --base)/envs/pyscf-env/bin/python -c "import fastapi, uvicorn, socketio; print(\"FastAPI ASGI stack verified\")" && echo "✓ All build tools verified"'
scripts.validate-build: bash -c 'CONDA_BASE=$(conda info --base 2>/dev/null || echo "$HOME/miniforge3") && source "$CONDA_BASE/etc/profile.d/conda.sh" && conda activate pyscf-env && $(conda info --base)/envs/pyscf-env/bin/python scripts/validate-build-completeness.py'
scripts.test:main: ts-node --files src/main/backend-gunicorn.test.ts && ts-node --files src/main/backend-health.test.ts && ts-node --files src/main/backend-process.test.ts && ts-node --files src/main/renderer-entry.test.ts && ts-node --files src/main/electron-vite-config.test.ts
scripts.test:web: ts-node --files src/web/api/agent.test.ts && ts-node --files src/web/runtime-config.test.ts && ts-node --files src/splash/splash-html.test.ts
scripts.debug:config: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const configPath = path.join(__dirname, 'config', 'server-config.json'); console.log('Config file:', configPath); console.log('Exists:', fs.existsSync(configPath)); if (fs.existsSync(configPath)) { console.log('Content:', JSON.stringify(JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(configPath, 'utf8')), null, 2)); }"

author: kam6y
